---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new role, skill, command, or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A brief description of what you'd like added or changed.

## Type

- [ ] New role
- [ ] New skill
- [ ] New CLI command or helper
- [ ] New rule or gate
- [ ] New template
- [ ] Improvement to existing component
- [ ] Other:

## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? What workflow does it improve?

## Proposed Solution

How do you think this should work? Include details like:
- For roles: what domain, what tier, what it can do
- For skills: what the workflow looks like, what it outputs
- For commands: what it reads, what rows it prints

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you've thought about.

## Additional Context

Examples, references, or screenshots that help explain the request.
